verdict.rationale: Motion is a SaaS productivity platform, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, account or data deletion flows, or deletion policies. The API's "managing projects and tasks" and the "Permissions & Access Control" plan feature are adjacent capabilities, not user control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
